trust.method: Rolling one-month-ahead backtest over the last 6 months. Each month is scored with ensemble weights and interval widths estimated from the other months only (leave-one-month-out), so accuracy and coverage are out-of-sample.
trust.caveat: Measured on a controlled synthetic dataset; real retail data will be noisier.
